files.description:
REST API for Vani, Zoho's collaborative whiteboard. Manage editions, teams, spaces and zones; create and edit the objects on a zone canvas; and build whole structures — mindmaps, flowcharts, kanban boards and tables — in a single call.

This document contains every Vani API operation. The per-resource documents beside it (editions, teams, spaces, zones, elements, and the rest) are subsets of this one. Generate a client from this file OR from the per-resource files, not both: they describe the same operations, so generating from both produces duplicate types.
files.title: Vani API

files.description: Edition-level resources: the edition itself, its subscription, join requests, and templates.
files.title: Editions

files.description: Teams within an edition, their members, join requests, and role lookups.
files.title: Teams

files.description: Spaces (projects) within an edition, their members, join requests, and role lookups.
files.title: Spaces

files.description: Zones (documents) within a space: lifecycle, metadata, versioning, and per-zone sharing.
files.title: Zones

files.description: Create, read, update, and delete the objects on a zone canvas: shapes, connectors, group shapes, frames, and their text.
files.title: Elements

files.description: Content search across a team's zones, frames, comments, and members.
files.title: Search

files.description: Publish a space externally and manage the resulting public share.
files.title: External Share

files.description: Build whole structures in one call — mindmaps, flowcharts, kanban boards, stacks, and tables.
files.title: Structures

files.description: Deterministic placement, alignment, tidy layout, spatial queries, and connector routing.
files.title: Layout & Placement

files.description: Traverse the zone hierarchy, resolve relationships, and navigate visually between objects.
files.title: Navigation & Relationships

files.description: Cell, row, and column operations on table objects, and typed database_table records and schema.
files.title: Tables

files.description: Read and mutate text on any text-bearing object, including styling.
files.title: Text

files.description: Low-level batch read and mutation escape hatch over zones, frames, and objects.
